stories.title: Commanders building momentum, halt Bengals' 5-game win streak
stories.summary: The Commanders' defense held the potent Bengals in check and Washington has won three of four.

stories.title: SEC to consider termination of LSU's membership at Dec. 3 meeting
stories.summary: For the second time this year, the SEC is threatening to hold a vote of its chancellors and presidents on whether to kick LSU out of the league, according to a filing in federal court in Alabama on Monday.

stories.title: Luis plans to sue SEC, Sankey for damages over LSU saga, attorney says
stories.summary: RJ Luis Jr. will sue the SEC and commissioner Greg Sankey for damages in the days ahead, his attorney, Tony Clayton, told ESPN on Monday.

stories.title: Sources: Cubs shore up rotation, agree to free agent deal with LHP Rogers
stories.summary: The Cubs have agreed to a five-year, $120 million contract with free agent pitcher Trevor Rogers, sources told ESPN's Jesse Rogers.

stories.title: Georgia defensive coordinator Schumann to be next coach at Florida State
stories.summary: Georgia's Glenn Schumann, one of the country's top defensive coordinators and part of a staff that has the Bulldogs at No. 1 in the CFP rankings, agreed to a five-year deal to become the next coach at Florida State, the school announced Monday.
